blocker.summary: r457 fixed a real guard bug in draw_pinned()'s rectangle-list handling: the draw.index_format != 1u check applied unconditionally to every rectangle-list draw, including auto-indexed draws (index_address==0, indexed_draw=false) for which index_format is always 0 by construction (native_xenos.cpp's DRAW_INDX_2 decode). Since r435 established all real observed draws are auto-indexed, no real rectangle-list draw could ever be pinned -- a rejection guaranteed by code structure, not by shader registry coverage. Fixed by gating the check with indexed_draw &&. Verified: native ctest 11/11 (including ac6_native_xenos_tests, no regression), and a live traced probe against the real ISO confirms the '16-bit guest indices' rejection message is gone. Still no visible content this run: presented_frames=5 state=2, capture pixels=921600 non_black=0 distinct_colors=1 -- a distinct new rejection reason surfaced for the unblocked draws: 'MSAA render targets are not qualified this cycle', not yet investigated. Named for r458: investigate the MSAA rejection reason (likely another targeted fix, no oracle needed, same pattern as this cycle). Still open, non-blocking: (1) the first rejection reason characterized by r456 (pinned registry coverage) likely needs an oracle session -- user decision, not to be spent unilaterally; (2) once the wiring is judged mature, reconsider the backlog commit decision (r433/r434/r438/r454-r457); (3) update tools/prepare.py/build.py to default to the current ISO path (r452/r453, convenience only).
